description: Source code for a mock GPU video accelerator factory class, including implementation of GPU memory buffer management, shared memory region creation, and video encoder creation within the media namespace.

classes.name: GpuMemoryBufferImpl
classes.description: Implementation of gfx::GpuMemoryBuffer representing a GPU memory buffer with support for mapping, unmapping, and retrieving buffer properties.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new GPU memory buffer, returning a unique pointer to GpuMemoryBuffer.

methods.name: CreateSharedMemoryRegion
methods.description: Creates a shared memory region of specified size.

methods.name: ShouldUseGpuMemoryBuffersForVideoFrames
methods.description: Indicates whether GPU memory buffers should be used for video frames.

methods.name: ImageTextureTarget
methods.description: Returns the texture target for a given buffer format.
